## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      7 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 15 juil. 2026 - 20 juil. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Hennesey Family_, 20 juil. 2026, 1/5: "update 7/26: it gets worse with every UI update. Functionality (i.e. sleep score) is broken half the time, and the UI isn't as good as Fitbit. this app is garbage compared to the Fitbit app. when my sensor breaks switching brands."
            2. _Sergey Solod_, 20 juil. 2026, 1/5: "It's like the app was developed by an inexperienced junior - it constantly freezes. And it's lagging! Shame. PS Their answer sounds - how can I put this - funny. They recommended that I restart the phone and relaunch the app. Google Team, please, train your answering bot to be less generic."
            3. _Dana_, 20 juil. 2026, 1/5: "Very buggy and overall too convoluted compared to the original fitbit app. Not sure how much money google offers these companies to sell out, but it's gotta be a lot when things change exponentially for the worse and then stay that way no matter how much pushback they receive. I've tried all the clearly AI prompted answers from the comments here in the responses to poor reviews and nothing has helped. I hate leaving bad reviews, but this app deserves it, unfortunately"
<!--/ir-theme-->
